visual_description: The image shows a vintage recording setup on a metal cart against a plain background. A large-diaphragm condenser microphone hangs from an adjustable boom arm above the equipment. On the cart’s surface are two devices: a wooden-based mechanical recorder with rollers and levers on the left, and a gramophone-style horn speaker mounted on a wooden base on the right. A label on the front of the cart reads “LIBRARY OF CONGRESS MAGNETIC RECORDING LABORATORY.” A cloth bag and red case rest beside the horn device. The lighting casts soft shadows behind the objects. No charts, tables, or numerical data are visible.
